title: Kirby Problem 5.3
exact_target: The Hilbert--Smith assertion asks whether every locally compact group acting faithfully and continuously on a connected manifold is a Lie group. The companion question concerns an action of a Cantor group on a Euclidean neighborhood retract: must the subset $A$ of points with trivial stabilizer be a homology-$Z$-subset? This homological negligibility means that $H_*(U,U\setminus A;\mathbb Z)=0$ for every open subset $U$ of the ambient neighborhood retract.
